newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE UP AFTER ACQUISITION NEWS, BANKS DOWN.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE UP AFTER ACQUISITION NEWS, BANKS DOWN.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse on Thursday was 37.7
million kroons versus 55 million kroons on Wednesday.
* The Talse index lost 1.54 percent to close at 255.11.
* Rakvere meat factory rose by 0.62 kroons to
close at 16.12 kroons in trade of 9.6 million kroons after it
released its 1996 audited results and announced that it had
acquired a 67 percent stake in the Riga Meat Factory.
* On the main list, Hoiupank was most traded in
turnover of 8.5 million kroons to end 1.75 kroons lower at 130
kroons.
* Dealers said the demand for Rakvere may continue and the
prices of banking shares were seen easing.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)

Rakvere meat factory remained in demand on Thursday and dealers said that the news of its acquisition of a 67 percent stake in the Riga Meat Factory, released after the market closed, would push its price further.
Rakvere also released its 1996 audited results on Thursday which showed a net profit of 4.337 million kroons compared to two million kroons according to unaudited figures.
"The audited results were not such a big deal, but the acquisition... the in Riga factory was," one dealer said.
All banking sector shares lost on the main list and Tallinna Pank was the biggest loser, falling 5.21 percent to close at 60 kroons versus 63.30 kroons.
Dealers said that the local rumour mill has it that the newspaper Aripaev will publish negative news tomorrow on Tallinna Pank, a fact confirmed by the paper.
Selling pressure was expected to continue bringing other banking shares down.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400, reuters@reuters.ee
